aliases: directory 'annotations' | PluginRegistry id 'annotations' | storeKey 'annotation' (SINGULAR) | CEB verb 'annotation.create' | TWO distinct stores named AnnotationStore -- see A and B.
headline: THE ONE FAMILY IN BATCH B5 THAT IS NOT DEAD. Its CEB channel IS an orphan exactly like the other three, but that channel is not its render path: the bus handler reaches the canonical store DIRECTLY via a deliberate store-singleton import (ANN-ONE-STORE). Ranking it beside grid/dimension/structural on the strength of the orphan event would be the D2 error in reverse.

doctrine.D1: Every ABSENT claim carries its command and output.
doctrine.D2: The orphan CEB channel is real and reported -- but it is NOT the first failing link, because the family reaches its render/persist store without it.
doctrine.D5: renders_plan and persists are proven from their own read sites, not inferred from dispatchability.
doctrine.D6: No plugin-owned test is used as a registration proof.

A_registration.two_stores_warning: THE STOREKEY IS CORRECT AND THE STORE IS STILL THE WRONG ONE. plugins/annotations/src/handlers/canonicalAnnotationSink.ts states it in full: PRYZM carries TWO disjoint annotation stores -- (1) ctx.stores.annotation, a flat AnnotationsState record map, and (2) the ADR-0119 SUBSYSTEM annotationStore (plugins/annotations/src/subsystem/AnnotationStore.ts). '(2) is CANONICAL ... (1) is read by NOTHING. Every write to it was a write into a void.' The descriptor binds (1). The gap is closed at the HANDLER, not at the registration -- see B.

B_handler.validates_before_mutation: YES. canExecute() checks kind against isAnnotationKind, anchor via isFiniteVec3, rotation finiteness and textHeightMm bounds against ANNOTATION_TEXT_HEIGHT_MAX_MM. Typed AnnotationSchemaError is thrown on a failed Annotation.parse AND on a failed sink projection (ADR-0299 RECOVERY-MUST-REFUSE: 'a projection that cannot land throws. A create that reached no store must never resolve as a success').
B_handler.mutates_only_via_immer_draft: NO -- AND THIS IS DELIBERATE AND LOAD-BEARING. The handler calls sinkCreate(...) from ./canonicalAnnotationSink.js, which does `import { annotationStore } from '../subsystem/AnnotationStore.js'` and then `annotationStore.add(el)` -- a direct write to a STORE SINGLETON inside execute(). C11 5.2 says 'Mutate stores ONLY via Immer draft (the stores argument). MUST NOT import store singletons directly.' This is a MUST violation, it is documented as ANN-ONE-STORE, and it is the ONLY reason a bus-created annotation is visible at all. The Immer write to ctx.stores.annotation is retained as the patch ledger the ring buffer needs; canonicalAnnotationSink.ts:assertNotARead() states the boundary in code and throws if anyone treats it as an element source.
B_handler.geometry_deferred_to_FrameScheduler: N/A -- annotation geometry is 2-D canvas draw work performed by the render layer on the unified frame loop, not by the handler.
B_handler.emits_typed_domain_event: NO -- the handler emits nothing; CEB does. C11 11.1. (The canonical store emits its own storeEventBus event and _notify fan-out on add, which is what actually drives the redraw.)
B_handler.otel_span: YES -- withHandlerSpan wraps execute, and every sink entry point opens its own span (annotation.sink.create / .lift / .update / .delete / .style / .params / .mirror).
must_not_violations: C11 5.2 'MUST NOT import store singletons directly' -- via canonicalAnnotationSink.ts importing the subsystem annotationStore. Deliberate (ANN-ONE-STORE); it is the fix, not the defect. It should be reclassified in C11 5.2 as the sanctioned exception, or the descriptor should bind the canonical store -- either way the contract and the code currently disagree.
B_handler.id_pre_generated_in_tool: YES for all three live callers. GridPlanToolHandler.ts:331 makeAnnotationElement(createId('annotation'), ...) then :352 executeCommand('annotation.create', ann); packages/geometry-roof/src/RoofSlopeSymbolBuilder.ts:205 the same shape; plugins/annotations/src/tool.ts:127 (TextNoteTool). The handler falls back to (cmd.id ?? createId('annotation')). CreateAnnotation.ts also carries a RICH PAYLOAD PASSTHROUGH branch (isFullElementPayload) so a caller that already built a subsystem AnnotationElement is stored verbatim rather than flattened -- its own comment records that flattening 'is why grid bubbles placed from the plan grid tool were never created.'

C_lifecycle.ceb_payload_geometry_complete: NO. Reads only { levelId?: string }; emits { commandId, commandType:'annotation.create', levelId }. No id, no anchor, no kind, no geometry2D. C11 10.2 Bridge Invariant 1 violated -- but see the note below on why this is not the family's first failing link.
C_lifecycle.initTools_bridge_evidence: grep -rn "'annotation.created'" --include=*.ts apps packages plugins src (node_modules excluded) -> exactly 2 hits: CommandEventBridge.ts:1268 (emit) and packages/runtime-composer/src/types.ts:965 (type). Zero subscribers repo-wide. Confirmed by audit/.../raw/check-mirror-reachability.log ARM E2, which names annotation.created among the 9 orphan channels.
C_lifecycle.why_the_orphan_channel_is_not_fatal_here: The bridge pattern exists to mirror a plugin DTO record into a LEGACY geometry store that a fragment builder reads. Annotations have no such twin: the handler writes the canonical subsystem store DIRECTLY, and that store emits its own storeEventBus event plus an onChange fan-out (plugins/annotations/src/subsystem/AnnotationStore.ts:121-127 add, :172-178 update, :185-191 remove, :312-348 the dimension trio). The renderers subscribe to THAT, not to runtime.events. So the orphan CEB channel is a real C11 10.2 breach and a real observability gap, and it is NOT what would stop an annotation appearing.

C_lifecycle.update_verbs_covered: NO ELEMENT_UPDATE_VERBS ROW -- AND IT DOES NOT MATTER, WHICH MAKES THE LEDGER WRONG. All eight mutating verbs project into the canonical store through the sink: grep -n 'sinkUpdate|sinkDelete|sinkStyle|sinkParameters' plugins/annotations/src/handlers/*.ts -> DeleteAnnotation.ts:54 sinkDelete, MoveAnnotation.ts:77 sinkUpdate, SetAnnotationColor.ts:67 sinkStyle, SetAnnotationKind.ts:63 sinkUpdate, SetAnnotationRotation.ts:62 sinkParameters, SetAnnotationText.ts:62 sinkParameters, SetAnnotationTextHeight.ts:70 sinkStyle, UpdateAnnotation.ts:86/94/98 sinkUpdate+sinkStyle+sinkParameters. So annotation is the ONE family in this batch that is NOT create-mirror-without-update-mirror.

A <canvas> element absolutely positioned over the 3D viewport. Renders all annotations owned by the currently active view ... projecting model-space points through the live camera.' first_failing_link_note: annotation clears authored -> dispatchable -> reachable -> renders_3d -> renders_plan -> persists, and fails first at EXPORTS. It is the only family in batch B5 that gets past 'reachable'. Its orphan CEB channel is a real breach and is reported as B5-ANN-02, but it is not the first failing link and treating it as one would send a lane to build a bridge the family does not need.

E_c11_cross_check.matrix_row: NO ROW. C11 11's 14 rows do not include Annotation.
E_c11_cross_check.prose_claim: C11 11.11 (:1497): 'Annotation (separate subsystem): annotations render through AnnotationManager + PlanViewAnnotationRenderer, not the geometry-element bridge. Runtime logs confirm [CommandManager] EXECUTE: CREATE_ANNOTATION and annotation injection into plan views. Functional; outside the geometry-pipeline scope.'
E_c11_cross_check.verdict: CONFIRMS THE OUTCOME, REFUTES THE MECHANISM AS STATED FOR THE BUS VERB. The rendering claim is correct and I reproduce it independently (D.renders_plan). But 11.11's evidence is the LEGACY CommandManager path ('EXECUTE: CREATE_ANNOTATION'), and at the time it was written the BUS verb annotation.create was NOT functional: canonicalAnnotationSink.ts's own header records that ctx.stores.annotation 'is read by NOTHING. Every write to it was a write into a void', and CreateAnnotation.ts:80-85 says 'Before this, the only effect of annotation.create was the ledger write below, which nothing renders, persists or exports; every caller of this verb created an annotation that did not exist.' A reader taking 11.11 as blanket approval of the family would have shipped bus-created annotations into the void for as long as that gap was open. The doc is right today for a reason it does not state.
E_c11_cross_check.also_stale: tools/ga-gate/mirror-debt.json still lists eight annotation.* verbs (:6 delete, :14 move, :22 setColor, :30 setKind, :38 setRotation, :46 setText, :54 setTextHeight, :62 update) as kind 'UNMIRRORED' with the SEEDED BACKLOG text 'it commits, reports success, and changes nothing the user can see.' Measured: every one of the eight projects into the canonical store through the sink (see C.update_verbs_covered). The ledger's own instruction covers this case -- 'a row whose reason still begins SEEDED BACKLOG has NOT been investigated ... replacing it with a measured sentence is the first half of closing the row.'

findings.claim: CreateAnnotationHandler (and all eight sibling verbs) mutate a STORE SINGLETON imported inside the handler -- canonicalAnnotationSink.ts imports the subsystem annotationStore and calls .add/.update/.remove directly. C11 5.2 forbids exactly this. It is deliberate (ANN-ONE-STORE) and it is the reason the family works, so the contract and the code disagree and one of them must move.

annotation.create's CEB case emits a levelId-only payload and annotation.created has zero subscribers repo-wide. Unlike the other three B5 families this does not break rendering -- but it means no observer, mirror, sync client or future bridge can learn that an annotation was created from the bus.

findings.claim: No export surface carries annotations or dimensions. A drawing exported to IFC, PDF or DXF loses every note, tag and dimension the user authored -- for a documentation family this is the whole point of the artefact.

C11 11.11 marks Annotation functional on the strength of the LEGACY CommandManager path, while the bus verb it shares a name with was writing into a void until ANN-ONE-STORE landed. The verdict was right, the evidence did not cover the verb. C11 11's normative matrix also carries no annotation row.
